list.name: track
list.label: Track
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT track FROM race_sessions ORDER BY track

list.name: class
list.label: Class
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT car_class FROM race_sessions ORDER BY car_class

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rr.player_id) AS value FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}'
SELECT AVG(duration_ms) AS value FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}'

SELECT 100*SUM(rr.dnf=1)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM race_results rr JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}'

SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at,'1d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS races FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT track, COUNT(*) AS races FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' GROUP BY track ORDER BY races DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT car_class AS class, COUNT(*) AS races FROM race_sessions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' GROUP BY car_class

SELECT tr.track AS Track, tr.car_class AS Class, p.username AS Driver, tr.best_time AS BestTimeMs, tr.best_lap AS BestLapMs, tr.set_at AS SetAt FROM track_records tr JOIN players p ON p.id=tr.player_id WHERE tr.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' ORDER BY tr.best_time ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT rs.created_at AS Time, rs.track AS Track, rs.track_type AS Type, rs.car_class AS Class, rs.laps AS Laps, rs.player_count AS Starters, ROUND(rs.duration_ms/1000,1) AS DurationSeconds FROM race_sessions rs WHERE $__timeFilter(rs.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' ORDER BY rs.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT rr.created_at AS Time, p.username AS Driver, rs.track AS Track, rr.position AS Position, ROUND(rr.finish_time/1000,2) AS FinishSeconds, ROUND(rr.best_lap/1000,2) AS BestLapSeconds, rr.dnf AS DNF, rr.dnf_reason AS DNFReason FROM race_results rr JOIN players p ON p.id=rr.player_id JOIN race_sessions rs ON rs.race_id=rr.race_id WHERE $__timeFilter(rr.created_at) AND rs.track REGEXP '${track:regex}' AND rs.car_class REGEXP '${class:regex}' ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeGroup(pr.ended_at,'1d') AS time, CONCAT(po.phase, ': ', po.option_key) AS metric, SUM(po.vote_count) AS votes FROM race_poll_runs pr JOIN race_poll_options po ON po.poll_id=pr.poll_id AND po.attempt=pr.attempt WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.ended_at) GROUP BY time, metric ORDER BY time
SELECT 100*SUM(rerolled=1)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS value FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at)
SELECT 100*AVG(voter_count/NULLIF(eligible_count,0)) AS value FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rerolled=0

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ended_at,'1d') AS time, SUM(cop_chase_yes) AS YesVotes, SUM(cop_chase_no) AS NoVotes FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rerolled=0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT ended_at AS Time, race_type AS Type, eligible_count AS Eligible, voter_count AS Voters, track_winner AS Track, vehicle_winner AS Vehicle, traffic_winner AS Traffic, cop_chase AS Cops, rerolled AS Rerolled FROM race_poll_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(ended_at) AND rerolled=0 ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT 100
